title: Arcane Sculptor
summary: Arcane Sculptor is an Arcane Enhancement for Warframes that locks a Warframe's Ability Efficiency at up to 175% when creating an object using a Warframe ability.
extract:
Arcane Sculptor is an Arcane Enhancement for Warframes that locks a Warframe's Ability Efficiency at up to 175% when creating an object using a Warframe ability.

Effect

Acquisition

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.
Can be bought from Hunhow at Pontis Tower for 10  Emerald Talent and 10  Crimson Talent

Notes
Ability Efficiency is locked at (not increased by) the stated value when the Arcane activates.
It will provide no benefit if the default efficiency is equal to the Arcane's effect.
It will reduce efficiency if the default efficiency is higher than the Arcane's effect.
This is only true if the arcane is not at max rank. Otherwise, Arcane Sculptor provides the max amount of Ability Efficiency possible (outside of Lohk Surge buffs).
